Class Event

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.cards.Event
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Event>
Direct Known Subclasses:
HuntEvent, PaintingEvent, RitualEvent, SustenanceEvent
public abstract class Event extends Card implements Comparable<Event>
Base class for every event card. Events cannot be picked: they sit in the top row and are resolved automatically, in priority order, affecting the players.
